analysis.reasonEn: Previous 3 trading days maintained a wait-and-see approach. RSI at 41.9 continues to consolidate in the neutral zone, and ADX at 21.8 indicates an early stage of trend formation. Lack of multi-timeframe alignment warrants continued observation.
